text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout -> PRIVATE customer `AtlasEdge`
- target: dedicated-vpc (eu-west-1)
- model: redwood-2.1.4
- change window: 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC
- canary strategy: 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (10m)
- rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m, or latency p95 > 800ms vs baseline
- runbook: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/AtlasEdge-2026-04-02

maya: tagging @sasha for SRE approval. Need explicit pin for the model variant we serve for AtlasEdge (they require quantized runtime). Also confirm any KV cache migration notes.

sasha: quick check: we must pin to `redwood-2.1.4-ptq` (post-training quantized) because customer's on-prem nodes lack int8 kernels for the -qat build.
Please include this in the rollout config: ```yaml
modelVersion: "redwood-2.1.4-ptq"
forcePin: true
cacheMigration: incremental -> warmup=false
```
I also want autoscale disabled for the canary slices to keep behavior deterministic.

trent: noted. For canary routing, we'll use header-based slice: `x-atlasedge-slice: canary` so customer traffic is reproducible. Readiness probe will check kv-cache warmup flag before toggling 50% slice.

liam: attached release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/atlasedge-2.1.4 (please review). Also FYI: we'll surface a short "what changed" blurb in the customer portal and include rollback instructions.

ops_oncall: heads up: there's a database maintenance window in eu-west-1 at 02:30-02:45 UTC. That overlaps the canary -> 50% transition. Suggest we shift the change window by 60 minutes to avoid false positives.

maya: good catch @ops_oncall. Can we move to 03:00-04:00 UTC instead? That keeps local working hours down for EU support but avoids the DB maintenance.

sasha: shifting to 03:00-04:00 UTC is fine from infra side. I'll gate the final approval on a quick smoke test run in canary and the model pin included in the config.

trent: I'll update the deployment manifest and paste the final canary rollout command here before we lock the window.

deploy-bot: Updated schedule: 2026-04-02 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan unchanged. Waiting for final config snippet.

maya: final sign-off from me once trent drops the manifest and liam confirms release notes.

trent: final manifest (snippet): ```bash
rictl rollout start --customer atlasedge --env private --model redwood-2.1.4-ptq --canary 10,50,100 --canary-duration 600,600,600 --disable-autoscale-canary
```

liam: release notes confirmed and published. Link: https://docs.internal/release-notes/atlasedge-2.1.4 (published)

sasha: SRE approval: :white_check_mark: pinned model `redwood-2.1.4-ptq`, autoscale disabled for canary, rollback thresholds set. I'll be monitoring during the window.

maya: PM approval: :white_check_mark: moving forward with 03:00-04:00 UTC window. Inform customer and update portal message.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled and locked. Runbook link copied to thread. Will post deploy start + success events.

(reacts: :rocket: from maya, :eyes: from ops_oncall)
